SC stays coercive action against Tata Chemicals over environment damage to marine sanctuary
items.summary: The Supreme Court granted Tata Chemicals relief from coercive actions while reviewing a Gujarat High Court verdict. Senior advocate Abhishek Singhvi represented Tata Chemicals, emphasizing environmental degradation and encroachment issues. The high court previously dismissed the company's plea concerning government land used for wastewater discharge. Furthermore, the Gujarat Pollution Control Board has been tasked with assessing the environmental impact and remediation measures.

Honda targets 20% cost cuts, faster car development in India with Tata Technologies: Report
items.summary: Honda Motor aims to decrease costs and development times by outsourcing vehicle production to Tata Technologies in India. The partnership is expected to lead to significant savings of up to 20% and shorter development timelines. Honda is currently facing financial pressures and is shifting focus toward hybrids and cost-cutting measures. The first vehicle under this collaboration is a small SUV targeted for launch in 2028.
